Acquired from fully exploring all [[Central Tyria]]n maps. | type = Trophy | material type = Mystic | rarity = Legendary | value = 640 | bound = Account | collection = Legendary Weapon: Bolt; Legendary Weapon: Frenzy; Legendary Weapon: Frostfang; Legendary Weapon: Howler; Legendary Weapon: Incinerator; Legendary Weapon: Kamohoali'i Kotaki; Legendary Weapon: Kraitkin; Legendary Weapon: Kudzu; Legendary Weapon: Meteorlogicus; Legendary Weapon: Quip; Legendary Weapon: Rodgort; Legendary Weapon: Sunrise; Legendary Weapon: The Bifrost; Legendary Weapon: The Dreamer; Legendary Weapon: The Flameseeker Prophecies; Legendary Weapon: The Juggernaut; Legendary Weapon: The Minstrel; Legendary Weapon: The Moot; Legendary Weapon: The Predator; Legendary Weapon: Twilight | id = 19677 }} [[Gift of Exploration]] is an [[item]] earned from [[Map completion#World completion|World completion]] and used for crafting the [[Gift of Mastery]] (as a part of crafting a first generation [[legendary weapon]]) and the [[guild hall]] [[decoration]] [[Tyrian Globe]]. == Acquisition == * 2 Gifts of Exploration are rewarded upon [[Map completion#World completion|World completion]] – [[Map completion|map completing]] all explorable [[zone]]s in [[Central Tyria]]. Each [[character]] can achieve world completion only once and, therefore, can only earn two Gifts. == Used in == {{Recipe list by discipline}} [[de:Gabe der Erkundung]] [[es:Don de la exploración]] [[fr:Don d'exploration]]
